# Plan: Nemotron-H Hybrid Inference on 12GB CUDA GPU

## 1. Technical Analysis & Tensor Placement Strategy

### 1.1 Memory Budget Analysis (12GB GPU = ~11.9 GB usable)

| Tensor Category | Size Estimate | Placement Decision |
|---|---|---|
| **Mamba SSM weights** (per layer: `ssm_in`, `ssm_conv1d`, `ssm_dt_b`, `ssm_a`, `ssm_d`, `ssm_norm`, `ssm_out`) | ~3.2GB for 31B model (52 layers) | **GPU** - Critical path, high FLOPs |
| **Attention QKV + output** (per layer) | ~2.1GB | **GPU** - Standard attention path |
| **MoE experts** (down/up: `ffn_down_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`) | ~4.5GB for 8 experts | **CPU RAM** - Overflow strategy |
| **Shared experts** (down/up: `ffn_down_shexp`, `ffn_up_shexp`) | ~1.8GB | **CPU RAM** - Low utilization |
| **Router/logits** (`ffn_gate_inp`, `ffn_exp_probs_b`) | ~0.3GB | **GPU** - Small, needed per-token |
| **NextN/MTP draft heads** (`nextn.*`, `attn_post_norm`, MoE sub-layers) | ~1.2GB | **GPU** - Only if MTP enabled |
| **KV cache + activations** | Variable (1-4GB) | **GPU** - Standard allocation |

**Total GPU footprint**: ~7.5GB (SSM + Attention + Router + NextN)  
**Total CPU overflow**: ~6.3GB (MoE + Shared experts)  
**Safety margin**: ~0.1GB for scratch buffers
